scope: Bounded AC1021 reader compatibility for the tracked LibreCAD writer fixture's LTYPE_CONTROL and APPID_CONTROL empty-string footer profile.

source.provenance: Copied from an already-tracked LibreCAD test fixture; no new DWG content was generated.

authority.primary: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
constraints: The R2007 object-data size ends before the detached handle stream.
The optional string-stream flag is the final pre-handle field; zero means no string payload.
ODA LTYPE_CONTROL defines BYLAYER and BYBLOCK as hard-owner references; the fixture's soft-owner roles are retained as a compatibility observation and remain an integrity error.

behavior: Accepts the LTYPE footer only for the exact AC1021 root, one-entry BYBLOCK/BYLAYER/CONTINUOUS graph, null common handles, soft-owner role encoding, and zero trailer.
Accepts the APPID footer only for the exact AC1021 APPID_CONTROL root, one ACAD entry, null common handles, expected soft-owner role, and zero trailer.
Leaves the existing broader historical soft-pointer compatibility profile unchanged.
Retains role-integrity diagnostics; this does not qualify strict output.

malformedAndRetryControls.retry: The same DRW_ObjControl instance accepts the corrected source-profile frame after each rejection.

readback.result: The reader passes TABLES, publishes three LTYPE records and one APPID record, then reaches BAD_READ_OBJECTS.
readback.supportClaim: No support claim promoted; strict output remains blocked.
